_doc: Stream B (play-test 4, S7). Every planned settlement gets a perimeter, chosen by its size and its zone's archetype (stream E's sheet), drawn with proctown's town-edge kit (proctown/js/buildkit.js wallKitParts / fenceParts / gateLeafParts). tools/lib/zone-walls.mjs reads this file; change it -> re-bake the zones (node tools/bake-zone.mjs --province torbor_downs). `bySize` picks a style per settlement kind, `frontier` replaces it in a frontier-like zone (archetypes listed in `frontierArchetypes`), `towns` overrides one settlement by its slug. A style: material (kit kind: stone | cutstone | mudbrick | bone | palisade | barricade | rail | hedge | stake), tier (wall = curtain with towers and gatehouses; low = fence / barricade with gate posts), h (metres), thick (metres), seg (target metres between ring corners), towerEvery (metres along the wall between towers, 0 = only beside gates, -1 = none), margin (metres outside the outermost building), gate (gatehouse | posts | gap), tint (the colour the white kit is multiplied by). Every style is SOLID in nav.bin: a body only gets through at a gate (or over the water where a river runs through the ring).
